description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git format-patch' command options related to numbering patches, such as --numbered, --no-numbered, and related configurations. It contains setup, test cases, and assertions to verify patch numbering behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution, typically with a descriptive name.

methods.name: test_num_no_numbered
methods.description: Checks the number of patch subjects in the provided file, asserting the count matches expected.

methods.name: test_single_no_numbered
methods.description: Verifies that the patch file contains exactly one 'no-numbered' patch subject.

methods.name: test_no_numbered
methods.description: Verifies that the patch file contains exactly two 'no-numbered' patch subjects.

methods.name: test_single_cover_letter_numbered
methods.description: Checks for cover letter patch with numbered subject in the given patch file.

methods.name: test_single_numbered
methods.description: Checks that the patch file contains a single numbered patch subject.

methods.name: test_numbered
methods.description: Checks that the patch file contains multiple numbered patch subjects.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite/run.
